text:
Sam T: Heads-up: ACME pilot wants a controlled staging run. Product asks: dedicated 2-GPU slot, int8 experiment with fp16 fallback, and session-scoped KV cache. Need to align runtime/infra/security schedule.

Priya L: Ops constraints: staging pool must be isolated (no shared prestarts). Prefer Tue or Wed mornings UTC. Also need prewarm config and temporary quota bump.

Rohit K: Runtime check: int8 path will change memory layout + KV footprint. If session-only KV, we can avoid cross-tenant sharding but latency might increase for some flows.

Dena S: Security checklist: HSM-backed key for cache encryption, audit logs enabled, no outbound network calls from model. Also require a short threat assessment before canary.

Sam T: Can we do a canary first (10% traffic) then full soak? product wants clear rollback gates.

Rohit K: Proposed rollout steps:
- Reserve 2-GPU isolated pool
- Deploy fp16 baseline, run 24h perf capture
- Canary int8-v2 (10% sessions) with fp16 fallback
- Enable session KV-cache and soak 48h
Gate each transition on perf and security checks.

Priya L: reserve request: "staging-acme-2gpu" Tue 09:00 UTC for 48h. I checked infra calendar — Tue 09:00 looks free. Will file reservation and temporary quota now.

deploy-bot: Reservation created: staging-acme-2gpu (2 GPUs) from 1716680400 to 1716766800.

Lina M: Product acceptance criteria: p99 latency within +10% of baseline, no data exfil alerts, and a customer walkthrough doc. If embeddings are used, they must be disabled for pilot.

Rohit K: Config snippet for canary (will put in PR): ```runtime: \n  canary: true\n  quant_profile: "int8-v2"\n  kv_mode: "session"\nbatching: \n  window_ms: 15\n  max_batch: 8```

Dena S: I'll do the quick threat assessment tonight and post notes. KMS policy required: rotate 30d, audit retention 90d. No plaintext dumps.

Sam T: Timeline asks: Rohit to open PR with manifest + health checks by EOD. Dena to review security by tomorrow morning. Priya to confirm reservation and prewarm budget. Lina to draft customer runbook.

Priya L: Reservation + prewarm budget done. Noted prewarm=2 per GPU.

Rohit K: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pulls/734 — includes canary manifest, canary traffic rules, and /deploy/rollback endpoint.

Dena S: Reviewing PR now. Two quick items: ensure KMS key is distinct from prod and add audit webhook to security backlog.

Lina M: I'll finish the customer runbook draft and link it in this thread once ready.

Sam T: Great. If Dena signs off, schedule canary Tue 09:00 UTC. Rollback criteria: p95 > baseline *1.25, any data-leak alert, or >3% error rate increase.

Rohit K: Acknowledged. Will include automated checks and an emergency rollback flag.

Dena S: Security sign-off pending two minor changes in the PR. If those are resolved, greenlight tomorrow AM.

Sam T: Closing for now — keep updates here. :rocket:
